dimensions.familiarity: degree of recognition and repeated contact
dimensions.personal_trust: confidence in the person in private/social contexts
dimensions.command_confidence: confidence in the subject under authority/responsibility
dimensions.friendship_state: none, developing, friend, close_friend, strained, former_friend
dimensions.relationship_state: none, dating, established, strained, separated, former_partner

rules: Relationship dimensions are not collapsed into one universal score.
Edges are directional: A's trust in B may differ from B's trust in A.
Relationship changes require plausible events/interactions or explicit state transitions.
Professional respect and personal affinity are independent.
Romance and sexual interest apply only to adults.
Consent is not inferred from any relationship dimension.
Relationship state does not grant world knowledge.
AI consumes relationship state but does not authoritatively create it without validated events.
Initial nontrivial relationship edges require plausible shared-history provenance.
Off-screen relationship changes require plausible contact, time and event causes.
